title: Business Central 29: What’s New in the Word Add-in?
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 introduces improvements to the Word Add-in for document reporting, including a new Company Information dataset, an improved Table Builder for editing existing tables, reusable design components, and conditional content controls. These changes reduce repetitive work when building Word layouts and provide a more structured approach to report development.
key_points: Company Information dataset is now automatically available in all Word layouts, eliminating the need to duplicate company fields across multiple report datasets
The Table Builder can now edit existing tables by reopening them to add or change columns and modify table structure without full recreation
Reusable design components provide predefined formatting for addresses, field groups, amounts, signatures, and notes to create consistent document structures
Hide If conditional control allows content to be shown or hidden based on Boolean values from the report dataset
Theme and Header/Footer Layout samples help developers design consistent branding across documents

quotes.text: Business Central 29 introduces a dedicated Company Information dataset that is automatically available to Word layouts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Eliminates repetitive work by providing company fields once instead of duplicating them across multiple report datasets

quotes.text: With Business Central 29, you can reopen an existing table in the Table Builder and modify its definition.
quotes.why_it_matters: Avoids the need to recreate entire tables when layout requirements change, saving development time
